description:
pattern     bento-grid / features
surface     dark
kit         none
form        Columns 1–12 lead with section header and introductory context line, opening into an asymmetric 6-card bento grid (two prominent wide cards and four standard cards) each clad in frosted glass with vivid photography and descriptive copy. On mobile, the grid collapses to a single-column card stack.
copy
  eyebrow      CAMPUS ENVIRONMENT
  heading      Faculty Experience
  intro        The Faculty of Technological Studies at the University of Vavuniya provided the crucible where theory met relentless practical execution.
  card-1-title Lectures & Foundations
  card-1-desc  Where conceptual computing paradigms and algorithmic theory were debated, deconstructed, and mastered daily.
  card-2-title Workshops & Technical Labs
  card-2-desc  Endless hours spent at high-performance workstations configuring networks, testing databases, and stress-testing applications.
  card-3-title Clubs & Peer Communities
  card-3-desc  Fostering peer mentorship, collaborative open-source contributions, and active tech meetups across faculties.
  card-4-title Competitions & Hackathons
  card-4-desc  High-stakes overnight coding marathons where innovative problem-solving was tested against strict delivery clocks.
  card-5-title Events & Tech Symposia
  card-5-desc  Organizing cultural, academic, and technological symposiums that brought the whole university community together.
  card-6-title University Life & Camaraderie
  card-6-desc  The quiet moments between lectures, lifelong friendships formed under campus trees, and the shared spirit of growth.
image       16:10; set of 6 campus documentary photographs showing lecture hall lectures, server lab testing, student club collaboration, hackathon whiteboards, symposium presentation stage, and evening campus lawns; placed in each card header, treatment documentary; alt: Faculty of Technological Studies campus experiences at University of Vavuniya
motion      Header enters at 50ms; bento cards stagger entrance at 70ms intervals with 15px translate-Y.
plan check  heading placed; introduction line placed; set of 6 cards (lectures, workshops, clubs, competitions, events, university life) each with a photo, title and short description placed.
layout_description: Asymmetric six-card bento grid with top centered header block and responsive multi-column layout.
